primary: attached Claude Code session - ALWAYS, until the user says otherwise
fallback: openai / gpt-5, ONLY after 20 minutes of session silence
how_it_is_set: KL_PROVIDER=session, stored as a USER environment variable so it survives a daemon restart, the scheduled task and a reboot. It is no longer held only in one process's environment - that is exactly how it was silently lost on 2026-08-01, when a daemon restart brought the loop back on GPT-5 as primary without anything looking wrong.
note: Claude Code session decides. Zero API cost. REQUIRES a Monitor armed on daemon.log for DECISION NEEDED|AWAIT_SESSION|ALL PROVIDERS FAILED, or handoffs are written and never read. Nothing decides while no session is attached - open positions still hold their broker-side SL/TP, so the failure mode is no NEW trade rather than an unmanaged one.
